description: This file defines the SearchFormView class responsible for rendering and managing the search form UI in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for setting up search options, engine choices, pagination sizes, and rendering the form template.

classes.name: SearchFormView
classes.description: Handles the display and configuration of the search form, including search engines, modules, and pagination size options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SearchFormView with a template path.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares and assigns data such as engine options, module options, and size options to the Smarty template engine, then calls the parent display method.

methods.name: makeSizesFromConfig
methods.description: Creates an array of pagination sizes based on configuration settings, with error handling fallback.

methods.name: makeSizes
methods.description: Generates an array of size options between min and max, incremented by step, with validation checks and exception handling.
